facts.value: Exported void(Fighter_GObj*, Vec3*, Vec3*, lbColl_80008D30_arg1*, f32) helper. arg2 seeds coll_data.last_pos; arg1 seeds coll_data.cur_pos before mpColl_800471F8, after which the resulting collision position is copied into Fighter.cur_pos. arg3 is passed with a local HitCapsule to lbColl_80008D30. arg4 is used as a degree-like angle: add 360 once when negative, then keep that result for facing_dir < 0 or use 180 minus it otherwise. This is not general modulo normalization. Descriptive parameter names are not recovered canonical spellings, and parameter entity labels do not establish physical ABI registers.
facts.rationale: Repairs the baseline type fact's normalization and direct-position-equality overclaims using exact header and implementation behavior.

evidence.why: Exact parameter uses, map-helper copy order, descriptor call and angle branches.

facts.value: Per-invocation CaptureLikelike timer and release-request processing: subtract common-data x758, invoke ftCommon_GrabMash with x75C, then call it_802DB9F4 with capturelikelike.x0 only if the integer lvalue through mushroom.x4 equals zero and the updated grab_timer is <=0. Write 1 to that lvalue after the item call. Timer and mash processing continue with a nonzero latch. The callback does not itself eject the fighter, validate the owner, clamp the timer, guarantee expiration for arbitrary coefficients/floats, or establish reentrancy-safe one-shot behavior. Compiled equivalence of this latch to entry's capturelikelike.x4 remains unresolved.
facts.rationale: Replaces elapsed-time and unconditional one-shot wording with exact source ordering and item-request semantics while preserving layout uncertainty.
